nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 黄色的 28 路电车吱呀着爬上阿尔法玛。终点站只剩你和一位抱着旧纸袋的老奶奶，她似乎错过了应该下车的地方。

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: I meant to get off near the blue-tiled church. This city keeps moving its hills when I'm not looking.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 司机说蓝瓷砖教堂有两座。要找到正确的一座，你得问出更具体的信息。

options.text: 「What is near the church you're looking for?」

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: A tiny bakery with red chairs. My husband and I met there when the tram fare was much cheaper.

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: No street name, but there is a bakery with red chairs. Landmarks are kinder to memory than signs.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们沿下坡路找到红椅子的面包店。Dona Inês 从纸袋里拿出一封信，却在门口停住了。

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: The baker is my husband's brother. We stopped speaking years ago. I wrote an apology, but words feel heavier at the door.

options.text: 「You don't have to say everything. You can start with 'May we talk?'」
「Would you like me to give him the letter?」

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: May we talk? Yes. A small door for a large conversation. I can open that.

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: Thank you, but I should knock myself. Stay until I find the first sentence.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 门铃轻响。柜台后的老人抬起头，沉默片刻，然后拉开一把红椅子。Dona Inês 回头朝你笑了笑。

nodes.speaker: Dona Inês
nodes.text: The last stop was not a place after all. It was the moment I finally arrived at the conversation.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】电车铃声从坡顶传来，有些旅程绕了很远，只为说出第一句话。
